storyCards.headline: I Want To Break Free: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Queen's "I Want To Break Free" reached #45 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #45 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 8 weeks on the chart.

I Want To Break Free was released in 2018.

Album: Bohemian Rhapsody (Soundtrack) (2018).
